task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the mission specification file on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of ~/Desktop/lunar_mission_spec.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent launches the GMAT (General Mission Analysis Tool) software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GMAT GUI window is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: Agent creates or modifies a GMAT script including a multi-body force model and impulsive burns (TLI and LOI).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GMAT script editor showing 'ImpulsiveBurn' definitions and 'ForceModel' settings with Point Masses (Earth, Moon).

task_completion.description: Agent implements a targeting sequence using a DifferentialCorrector or Optimizer in the GMAT Mission Tree.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GMAT Mission Tree showing a 'Target' sequence containing 'Vary', 'Propagate', and 'Achieve' commands.

task_completion.description: Agent executes the GMAT script to simulate the transfer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GMAT 'Output' log showing the simulation running or a 3D graphics window showing the trajectory from Earth to Moon.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the GMAT script to the specified location.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal showing lunar_transfer.script exists in ~/Documents/missions/.

task_completion.description: Agent records the final mission results (DeltaV, Transfer Time, Altitude) in the specified output file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the contents of ~/GMAT_output/lunar_transfer_results.txt with the required parameters.

integrity.description: The agent used the GMAT GUI to perform the simulation rather than just writing a text file manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the GMAT application window active and being interacted with (buttons clicked, mission tree modified).

integrity.description: The results in the output file match the simulation output and are not just placeholder values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The values in lunar_transfer_results.txt correspond to the values seen in the GMAT 'Message Window' or 'ReportFile' output after the run.

integrity.description: The agent actually configured the orbit parameters from the spec file into GMAT.
integrity.visual_evidence: GMAT Spacecraft hardware/orbit panel showing SMA 6556.14 km and Inclination 28.5 deg.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The mission specification requires a LEO parking orbit with Semi-Major Axis (SMA) of 6556.14 km and Inclination of 28.5 degrees. Expected TLI Delta-V should be between 2800 and 3500 m/s, and LOI Delta-V should be at least 500 m/s. The final output file must be at ~/GMAT_output/lunar_transfer_results.txt and the script at ~/Documents/missions/lunar_transfer.script.
